priority: P1 — protect the already-integrated Discord /dupla convidar seat order and default mode without modifying the Mission 8-preserved bootstrap.

implementation.behavior: A source-contract assertion checks the real /dupla convidar handler still passes [host, opponent1, partner, opponent2] and defaults to classic-loan. A temporary SQLite integration then accepts all four participants and proves tagStore persists teams [0,1,0,1], so host+partner share a team and both opponents share the other. Duplicate IDs are rejected before any session/seat lock; no inventory/deck rows are created.
implementation.blockedRuntimeAttempt: An earlier isolated draft attempted a helper import in src/index.ts. Card Batch Fast/Mission 8 rejected it because the bootstrap-preservation hash changed. The branch now restores src/index.ts byte-for-byte to the shared baseline and removes the unused helper; no gate was bypassed.

limitations: The test asserts the existing inline Discord command source and executes its seat order through tagStore; it does not import the full Discord client or connect to a live guild.
No new card effect or certification.
